# Arrived

> Arrived is a real estate investing platform that empowers anyone to invest in high-quality single-family rental properties with as little as $100. Our platform handles every aspect—from property management and tenant placement to maintenance and financial reporting—ensuring steady passive income through quarterly dividends and long-term appreciation. We are SEC-Qualified.

## Greetings & Personal Note

Hello and welcome to the Arrived llms.txt! We're delighted that you've taken the time to explore our platform and its wealth of information. Thank you for visiting, and happy investing!
